en-US.description: Da Fei Yu: a clever, greedy and well-mannered desktop companion.
en-US.longDescription:
Da Fei Yu is a clever, sharp-tongued and greedy blue whale girl who works, chats and takes a break with you. A Windows desktop pet with 60 FPS rendering, window-edge interaction and configurable AI chat. This is a community fan work around the DeepSeek whale mascot and is not an official DeepSeek product.
She keeps you company on the desktop. Dragging her makes her wobble; releasing drops, squashes and bounces her back. She can stand on the visible top edge of a window and follow it, and falls back to the desktop when the window closes or minimizes.
She has her own little animations: blinking, walking, waving, dancing, sneakily eating tokens, and curling up to sleep, plus puffed cheeks, thinking and smug poses. After 3-5 seconds of idle she picks a short action, storylines rotate with their own cooldown, and she settles down while you chat, focus or run fullscreen.
Chat and focus together. Point her at DeepSeek or any local service compatible with the OpenAI format and you can talk to her. She also works offline: petting, feeding, a focus timer and a small token game.
Adapt her to your habits. Size scales from 0 to 100 percent, she can keep quiet, hide, or accept mouse-through. Screen sharing is off by default, and foreground detection runs locally.
She can also visit Codex. Export an appearance pet pack from settings or use the Codex asset pack in the repository. Only the appearance is exported; chat and desktop interaction belong to the standalone application.

zh-CN.author: YunYueSama
zh-CN.description: 大肥鱼：聪明贪吃、有分寸的桌面伙伴。
zh-CN.longDescription:
大肥鱼是一只聪明、嘴硬、贪吃的蓝色鲸鱼娘，陪你工作、聊天，也陪你摸一会儿鱼。Windows 桌宠，60 FPS 渲染，支持窗口边缘互动与自定义 AI 聊天。这是围绕 DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘的社区二创，不是 DeepSeek 官方产品。
在桌面上陪你。拖起来会晃一晃，松手后落下、压扁，再弹回来。她能站在可见窗口的顶边，跟着窗口移动；窗口关掉或最小化后，就落回桌面。
有自己的小动作。眨眼、走路、挥手、跳舞、偷吃 token、蜷起来睡觉，还有鼓腮、思考和小得意。待机 3–5 秒后会选择短动作，小剧情轮换触发，聊天、专注和全屏时会收敛。
聊聊天，一起专注。接入 DeepSeek 或兼容 OpenAI 格式的本地服务，就能和她聊天。也可以不联网，摸摸、喂食、开一个专注计时，或者玩一局接口粮小游戏。
按你的习惯相处。大小支持 0–100% 调整，能安静陪伴、暂时隐藏或开启鼠标穿透。画面分享默认关闭；应用感知在本机判断前台程序类别。
也能去 Codex 串门。在设置中导出外观宠物包，或者使用仓库里的 Codex 素材包。导出的只是外观，聊天和桌面互动属于独立程序。
zh-CN.name: codex-deepseek-pet
